action: Choose the edit way of the data row for the work of the data row (Edit by Modal opens from a selected row).
Type the typed value of the data row in the Deck field and press Enter.
result: The value shows `Main Deck` as soon as it is entered.

action: Open the Worklist page and read the Deck cell of the work of the data row.
result: The cell shows `Main Deck, Helideck`: `Main Deck` first.

action: Return to the same edit way of the same work and type the 31-character value in the Deck field.
result: The field keeps 30 characters and the 31st character is not accepted, the same as in the Create Work form.
The Deck value of the work is unchanged and no 31-character value is saved.

action: Select the Deck cell of work `WK-18g` in the Gantt table.

result: The cell holds the first 30 characters `Deck-0123456789-0123456789-ABC` and no error shows (truncated).

action: Paste the copied text `main deck` in the same cell.
Select the Y cell of work `WK-18g` and paste the text `a`.
Open the Worklist page and read the Deck and Y cells of `WK-18g`.
result: Deck shows `Main Deck` and Y shows `A`.
